import os
import tempfile
import shutil
import pytest

# Import the public API that is available in the codebase
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.vcs.mockvcs import WorkingCopy
from doorstop.core import editor
from doorstop.core import importer
from doorstop.core import exporter
from doorstop.core import publisher
from doorstop.core import tree
from doorstop.core import types
from doorstop.core import common

# Helper to create a temporary document in a temporary directory
@pytest.fixture
def temp_doc(tmp_path):
    """Create a new Doorstop document in a temporary directory."""
    # The Document constructor expects a path to the document directory
    doc_path = tmp_path / "doc"
    doc_path.mkdir()
    # Create a minimal YAML file for the document
    yaml_path = doc_path / "doc.yaml"
    yaml_path.write_text("title: Test Document\n")
    # Instantiate the Document
    doc = Document.load(yaml_path)
    yield doc
    # Clean up
    shutil.rmtree(tmp_path, ignore_errors=True)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test cases
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001(temp_doc):
    """
    Unique Identifier - Single Section
    """
    doc = temp_doc
    # Create a single item
    item = doc.add_item(level=types.Level(1), reorder=False)
    # The UID should be unique and permanent
    assert isinstance(item.uid, str)
    assert item.uid.startswith("REQ")
    # Retrieve the item by UID
    retrieved = doc.find_item(item.uid)
    assert retrieved is item


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_002(temp_doc):
    """
    Unique Identifier - Multiple Sections (count=1)
    """
    doc = temp_doc
    items = []
    for _ in range(1):
        items.append(doc.add_item(level=types.Level(1), reorder=False))
    uids = {i.uid for i in items}
    assert len(uids) == 1  # only one item, so only one UID


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_003(temp_doc):
    """
    Unique Identifier - Multiple Sections (count=5)
    """
    doc = temp_doc
    items = []
    for _ in range(5):
        items.append(doc.add_item(level=types.Level(1), reorder=False))
    uids = {i.uid for i in items}
    assert len(uids) == 5  # each item has a unique UID


def test_U01_2__Gherkin_BDD___TC_004(temp_doc):
